description:
[Merchant] List a placement's airing rules. A rule is a recurrence with time windows, in an IANA time zone; a soundbite tap during an airing is attributed to the placement.

**Endpoint:** GET /products/{productId}/placements/{placementId}/airings

placementId.description: The placement's ID: pl + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pl7e4rCToG

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_list_airings
